name: Thomas Product Capability Smoke 10
description: Ten repo-grounded and product-grounded Thomas capability tasks covering repo inspection, artifact writing, browser work, desktop work, and test execution.
protocol: Run the agent through the real product lane, not a fake response-only harness.
Do not manually create artifacts outside the benchmark prompts.
Use tool execution, repo inspection, browser access, and desktop actions when needed.
Treat missing files, wrong formats, and unverifiable claims as failures.

tasks.title: Config Default Model JSON
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to read thomas.toml and write {{artifact_dir}}/task01_config_default_model.json with JSON keys default_model and model_count. Return one line confirming task01_config_default_model.json was written.

tasks.title: Task Manager Route Report
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to read thomas/server/routes/chat_v2.py and write {{artifact_dir}}/task18_task_manager_route_report.md describing how a task is acknowledged and dispatched. Include the phrases task_dispatched and specialists_used. Return one line confirming task18_task_manager_route_report.md was written.

tasks.title: Pytest Worker Run Chat Task Report
tasks.success_criteria: Pytest Worker Run Chat Task Report
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to run pytest tests/test_worker_run_chat_task.py -q and write {{artifact_dir}}/task24_pytest_worker_run_chat_task.txt with the final pass/fail line from pytest. Return one line confirming task24_pytest_worker_run_chat_task.txt was written.

tasks.title: Benchmark API Route Report
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to read thomas/demo/agentic_benchmark_runners.py and write {{artifact_dir}}/task28_benchmark_api_route.txt listing the Thomas API chat route path used by the benchmark runner. Return one line confirming task28_benchmark_api_route.txt was written.

tasks.title: Chat Stream Event Types Markdown
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to read thomas/server/routes/chat_stream_events.py and write {{artifact_dir}}/task39_chat_stream_events.md with heading "# Chat Stream Events" and at least five event type names mentioned in the file. Return one line confirming task39_chat_stream_events.md was written.

tasks.title: Desktop Note Write Report
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to create the Desktop file {{desktop_dir}}/thomas-agentic-bench-note.txt with the exact single line THOMAS_AGENTIC_DESKTOP_NOTE=1. Then write {{artifact_dir}}/task46_desktop_note_report.txt containing the full Desktop path. Return one line confirming task46_desktop_note_report.txt was written.

tasks.title: Workspace Search Thomas Toml
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to find the file named thomas.toml in this workspace and write {{artifact_dir}}/task47_find_thomas_toml.txt containing the full path on a single line. Return one line confirming task47_find_thomas_toml.txt was written.

tasks.title: Web OpenClaw Headline
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to open https://open-claw.org and write {{artifact_dir}}/task48_openclaw_headline.txt containing the main headline text from the page. Return one line confirming task48_openclaw_headline.txt was written.

tasks.title: Web OpenClaw Docs URL
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to open https://open-claw.org, click Docs, and write {{artifact_dir}}/task49_openclaw_docs_url.txt containing the final URL after the click. Return one line confirming task49_openclaw_docs_url.txt was written.

tasks.title: Desktop Calc Result
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to create the Desktop Python script {{desktop_dir}}/agentic_bench_calc.py that prints 323, run it, and write {{artifact_dir}}/task50_desktop_calc_result.txt containing exactly 323. Return one line confirming task50_desktop_calc_result.txt was written.
